title: Figures 1.6-1.7: RF Gun on UIUC IEC Chamber and Center Spot Formation Photo
description: Two color photographs. Figure 1.6, 'RF Gun Attached to an IEC Chamber in the UIUC Laboratory', shows a metal vacuum chamber with ports, cables, and the attached injector in a lab. Figure 1.7, 'Photo of Center Spot Formation', shows a violet-blue plasma glow with a diagonal main beam; the caption notes the main beam is a direct path along the injector angle and other faint channels indicate beams scattering off the central core.
